title: Palmatine alleviates cardiac fibrosis by inhibiting fibroblast activation through the STAT3 pathway.
authors: Lin, Shaoling; Zhang, Shengxi; Zhan, Angyu; Feng, Jiaojiao; Yang, Qianqian; Li, Tongjun; Liu, Zijian; Mo, Quqian; Fan, Hui; Wang, Keke; Wang, Lexun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过STAT3通路抑制心脏成纤维细胞活化缓解纤维化，仅涉及STAT3蛋白与药物分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cardiac fibrosis, the hallmark of cardiovascular disease, is characterized by excessive deposition of extracellular matrix in the heart. Emerging evidence indicates that cardiac fibroblasts (CFs) play pivotal roles in driving cardiac fibrosis. However, due to incomplete insights into CFs, there are limited effective approaches to prevent or reverse cardiac fibrosis currently. Palmatine, a protoberberine alkaloid extracted from traditional Chinese botanical remedies, possesses diverse biological effects. This study investigated the potential therapeutic value and mechanism of palmatine against cardiac fibrosis. Adult male C57BL/6 mice were treated with vehicle, isoproterenol (ISO), or ISO plus palmatine for one week. After echocardiography assessment, mice hearts were collected for histopathology, real-time polymerase chain reaction, and Western blot analyses. Primary rat CFs were utilized in vitro. Compared to control, ISO-treated mice exhibited cardiac hypertrophy and structural abnormalities; however, treatment with palmatine ameliorated these effects of ISO. Moreover, palmatine treatment mitigated ISO-induced cardiac fibrosis. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis showed that palmatine strongly binds the regulators of cardiac fibrosis including signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) and mammalian target of rapamycin. Furthermore, palmatine reduced the elevated fibrotic factor expressions and overactivated STAT3 induced by ISO, Transformed growth factor beta1 (TGF-beta1), or interleukin-6 both in vivo and in vitro. Additionally, blocking STAT3 suppressed the TGF-beta1-induced CF activation. Collectively, these data demonstrated that palmatine attenuated cardiac fibrosis partly by inhibiting fibroblast activation through the STAT3 pathway. This provides an experimental basis for the clinical treatment of cardiac fibrosis with palmatine.
abstract_zh: 心脏纤维化是心血管疾病的标志性特征，表现为心脏中细胞外基质过度沉积。新近证据表明，心脏成纤维细胞（CFs）在驱动心脏纤维化中发挥关键作用。然而，由于对CFs的认识尚不全面，目前预防或逆转心脏纤维化的有效方法有限。巴马汀（Palmatine），一种从传统中草药中提取的原小檗碱类生物碱，具有多种生物效应。本研究探讨了巴马汀对抗心脏纤维化的潜在治疗价值及其机制。成年雄性C57BL/6小鼠分别接受溶剂、异丙肾上腺素（ISO）或ISO联合巴马汀处理一周。超声心动图评估后，收集小鼠心脏进行组织病理学、实时聚合酶链反应和蛋白质印迹分析。体外实验使用原代大鼠CFs。与对照组相比，ISO处理的小鼠表现出心脏肥大和结构异常；然而，巴马汀治疗改善了ISO的这些效应。此外，巴马汀治疗减轻了ISO诱导的心脏纤维化。网络药理学和分子对接分析显示，巴马汀与心脏纤维化调节因子包括信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）和哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白强烈结合。进一步地，巴马汀在体内和体外均降低了由ISO、转化生长因子β1（TGF-β1）或白细胞介素-6诱导的升高的纤维化因子表达和过度激活的STAT3。此外，阻断STAT3抑制了TGF-β1诱导的CF激活。综上，这些数据表明，巴马汀部分通过STAT3通路抑制成纤维细胞激活，从而减轻心脏纤维化。这为巴马汀临床治疗心脏纤维化提供了实验依据。
